capabilities: Read notes aloud offline with neural Piper voices in Spanish and English
Highlight and scroll to the current sentence in Live Preview and Reading view
Resume each note's playback from its saved position
Control playback speed from 0.75x to 2.5x with preserved pitch
Install the Piper engine and voices with a separate Windows installer
extras: Windows x64 desktop only. The engine installer is unsigned, so Windows SmartScreen may warn; it is reviewable plain text. The plugin itself never uses the network; only the one-time installer downloads from GitHub and Hugging Face with pinned SHA-256 checks. Not yet manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in text-to-speech, and most TTS options rely on cloud services, accounts, or API keys.

relations.evidence: Potenciado por el motor de síntesis neuronal de código abierto Rhasspy Piper TTS.
eSpeak-NG: Motor de fonemización y reglas fonéticas de texto a habla.

requires.name: Piper engine and voices (installed by vocalis-setup.cmd)

summary: Offline neural text-to-speech that reads notes aloud with sentence highlighting in both views, per-note playback memory, and speed up to 2.5x.
